generatedBy: the existing LOCAL Sound Lab through tools/audio-pipeline/soundlab_runner.py (the task's local Sound Lab allowance: 5 jobs of a 12-job cap including retries, every first take accepted; the rest of the allowance closed unused)
plannedBy: tools/audio-pipeline/chipper-plan.py (ids, cues, durations, seeds; the prompt text stays with the private raw archive)
reuse: Checked first (audio/bank.ts): the Reactor / Bunker machine cues are a diesel generator, fan air, a servo ratchet, a beacon motor and a pump with water; bodyFall is a dry thud on concrete; nothing grinds wet flesh and bone. So five cues were generated, one take each.
privacy: This public record names each raw take by its Sound Lab job id, seed and SHA-256 (raw WAV, lab sidecar, prompt). The prompt text, the raw takes and their paths stay in the private raw archive (independent backup), not in Git.

license.review: NOT LISTENED TO on the worker (no audio output): structural analysis only (per-0.1 s level, per-0.25 s spectral centroid, spectrogram images, band shares, flatness, peak, clipping, silence, loop-seam step / level jump, BS.1770 loudness). The user taste-tests in game.

loudness.method: ITU-R BS.1770-4 K-weighting, 400 ms blocks / 75 % overlap; one-shots: maximum momentary loudness (zero-padded to one block); loops: integrated loudness of the loop played twice; sample peak (no true-peak oversampling)

mixCalibration.note: CUE_GAIN (audio/sfx.ts) per cue = 10^((target - measured) / 20), capped at 1 (no boost): the target is the cue's loudness at the source (derivative x CUE_GAIN, before distance / room / master). First estimates for the ear pass.

chipperMotor.why: the running motor: a bed in the car the player stands in, above the market murmur beds (-31), under every combat cue

chipperGrind.why: the wet grind over the motor while a body is processed: clearly heard, under combat

chipperFeed.why: a heavy body landing in the hopper: about an enemy attack (-20.3) / a market grunt (-21)

chipperStart.why: the switch clunk + spin-up: its steady part hands over to the motor loop (-28) as it fades, ~2 dB above it (no step)

chipperStop.why: the switch clunk + coast-down to silence: its running part takes over from the fading motor loop (-28) at about its level

ops: stationary window from 1 s (std 1.42 dB over 0.5 s blocks, searched from 0.8 s, end guard 1.6 s)
stationary window from 1.5 s (std 2.02 dB over 0.5 s blocks, searched from 1.5 s, end guard 2.1 s)
